demand_picture: The shared narrative of stable end-market demand and slight increases in contacts business across member companies suggests a moderate growth outlook for the sector.
margin_picture: While gross margins are expected to expand, EBITDA margins are forecasted at 18-19%, indicating a potential margin pressure due to increasing competition and cost pressures.
capex_picture: Capex behavior is largely aligned across member companies, with most expecting to maintain their guidance of 10-15 crore year-on-year additions, focusing on incremental capacity additions rather than large-scale investments.
divergences: [ divergence: SBCL's cautious optimism on H2 vs. Sambhv's neutral tone; BORORENEW's cautiously optimistic outlook compared to SAMBHV's neutral tone ]
key_callouts: [ 'Geopolitical tensions affecting supply chains and raw material costs' (SBCL), 'Dependence on government policies and regulations' (BORORENEW) are key risks across member companies ]
